notes.title: Eldgear confirmed to release on March 8th!
notes.notes:
The legacy of the magic civilization era ignites the flames of great turmoil! Authentic tactical SRPG "[b][i]Eldgear[/i][/b]" scheduled for release on 3/8! Wishlisting now open!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2541210/Eldgear/

The tactical SRPG that gained popularity on Japanese feature phones has undergone a complete character illustration renewal and is resurrected after 18 years! A genuine turn-based simulation RPG with over 25 stages. Seize victory by utilizing regular skills, two types of special skills, and over 10 characters!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34597517/970df698ad0814651afc4003be903c85faa75fc2.png[/img]

notes.title: A date for the English version of Raging Loop!
notes.notes:
We’re happy to confirm that the psychological horror adventure will be available in English starting December 5th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30435559/077b661757f6c323f7f8bea60e3cb9813513db87.jpg[/img]

Also known as Rei-Jin-G-Lu-P, the game was greeted by an enthusiastic response from critics and fans in Japan. Add it to your wishlist now if you haven’t already!
